Blog Upgrades

Andy CASA, UCL East

The blog is moving over to a beta version of blogger.. the old template is no longer operational so give us a few hours and we should have everything back in place..

*Update *

The beta version of blogger does not yet allow editing of the raw html so our template size cannot be changed. This is resulting in the side bar dropping off to the bottom of the page in IE6 but all is fine in Firefox.

As soon as html editing is included in Blogger we will get the site back up to scratch.. till then all the links are now structured so the site is easy to use and navigate.. if you can find the side bar!
